says: In today's tooling, oxlint-plugins/README.md has a paragraph for each lint step that is not an oxlint rule (exact-versions.ts, workspace-reach.ts), but none for the new tracked-scripts.ts step.
proof: grep -n -E 'exact-versions|workspace-reach|tracked-scripts' oxlint-plugins/README.md finds line 10 (exact-versions.ts is not an oxlint rule) and line 12 (workspace-reach.ts), and no line for tracked-scripts.ts, while package.json:11 runs 'node oxlint-plugins/tracked-scripts.ts'.
cost: A reader of the folder's map does not learn that pnpm lint refuses new shell and Python files, or where the shrinking list lives.
